question: May an existing membership row be re-bound to a new sign-in identity because the e-mail address matches, who verifies that the address belongs to the person, may a row already bound to another identity be re-bound, and what record is kept of the re-binding?
decision: Never link or rebind membership solely by matching an email. Initial link requires a verified identity claim plus proof of organization-controlled invitation or an approved admin assertion; only unbound memberships can be claimed, with replay-resistant single-use confirmation and audit. Rebinding an already-bound membership requires a separate authorized, dual-reviewed recovery with original/new identity provenance. Remove unaudited legacy auto-rebinding.
originalProposedDecision: No. Email match never re-binds a membership. Linking requires a verified email (the provider's verified claim or a one-time code) and only for rows with no current user id; an already-bound row is never re-bound except by an admin action that is audited. Remove the legacy branch.
